added_lines: . this weekend we’re delighted to be able to congratulate ardfert national school on winning the kerry cumann na m bunscol 8/9 teacher football competition . this is a wonderful achievement on the part of all involved and it’s the first time that the school has won this competition since 2014. in the final, which was played at austin stack park in tralee last tuesday, 20 october 2026, our bri lliant team turned in a tremendous performance to defeat a very good t eam from spa national school by 7 points (3-7 to 1-6). we say ‘well done’ to all the boys and girls in the team and panel and to their coach mr tomás hanafin a nd to mr paud costello, mr patrick moriarty and ms emma o’brien who assisted him in different ways. ard fhearta abú! the messenger – november issue is available in both c hurches cost €2 .50. please put monies in the candle shrine. november – remembering our beloved dead mass for parishioners who died during the year will be held on friday 20 november 2026 at 7 pm in saint brendan’s church, ardfert . if you would like someone to be remembered and prayed for in this mass, who passed away within the last 12 months and whose funeral was not in our parish, you are welcome to drop their name into the parish office and we will happily include them in our prayers at the memorial mass on 20 november. a candle will be lit on the altar i n memory of them all. all souls day (monday 2 november) . mass will be offered at 10 am in st brendan’s church, ardfert and at 7 pm in the sacred heart church, kilmo yley for all the faithful departed. november masses for the holy souls on the november lists will be held during november on wednesdays at 10 am in ardfert church and on mondays at 7 pm in kilmoyley church. please return your november envelopes for inclusion in these masses. if you do not have a box of envelopes, november envelopes are available in both churches . ardfert
